name: oauth-pkce-demo
description: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow + PKCE demo: separate Identity Provider and Client backend (Node.js + TypeScript)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n idp,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w idp" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w idp && npm run build -w client
scripts.start: concurrently -n idp,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w idp" "npm run start -w client"
